410.description: Receipt acknowledged or expired; reconcile the original outcome

post.summary: Durable agent credential operation (enroll, rotate, renew, disable); explicit admin:agents, workspace authorization and scope subset required; renew sets a new deadline for an active workspace member without widening its scopes and keeps the previous credential for a bounded grace period; encrypted receipt replay expires after fifteen minutes

delete.summary: Acknowledge exact credential receipt; owner and admin:agents required

post.summary: Acknowledge or dismiss readable owned-memory conflicts

Current product identity without bearer claims
Read permitted queue status and jobs

Build context for a readable session

get.summary: Read memory statistics; agent_id scopes every count to that agent's records (only that agent or an administrator)

post.summary: Create workspace; an archived ID cannot be reused

put.summary: Update workspace as owner or administrator
